title: form_encode is re-implemented in sms_client instead of reusing a shared encoder; the payment copy keeps the + bug
detail: Two form-encoders now exist; the corrected (+ to %2B) copy lives only in notification while payment/stripe_client retains the buggy one. Divergent copies will drift over time.
recommended_fix: Extract one shared form-encoder (with the + fix) into a common util and reuse it from both stripe_client and sms_client.

title: reference_checks/lookup depends on notification/sms_client for shared Twilio credentials and Basic auth
detail: The Twilio config handle, Enabled/Disabled variants, and basic_auth_header live under notification/, so the reference_checks domain reaches into notification for shared infra, coupling two unrelated domains.
recommended_fix: Lift the Twilio config/handle/basic_auth into a neutral module (e.g. integrations/twilio); have both sms_client and lookup depend on that.
